text:
carla: quick heads-up — we got formal migration requests from BigCorp and DataCo asking for longer pin windows + compatibility shims. need to decide where they sit in the migration queue.
ben: can we capture the ask in one line each (SLA, pin length, must-support-models)? makes scoring easier.
alice: BigCorp: 6mo pin, strict latency SLO, requires falconx adapter. DataCo: 3mo pin, needs embeddings parity, lower QPS.
dave: benchmarking note — falconx adapter currently fails at conv loss on long context in our perf suite. we should gate BigCorp until a patch or compatible shim exists.
eva: from sales — BigCorp has legal leverage on enterprise contract; losing them is high-risk. they say they'll pay for dedicated capacity if we commit to 6mo pin.
carla: ok tradeoff: revenue + dedicated vs engineering risk and potential perf regressions. propose short rubric: impact * 40% + engineering cost * -30% + regression risk * -30%.
ben: suggest concrete buckets so triage is fast. quick draft:
```
score = revenue_impact(1-5)*40 + eng_hours(1-5)*-30 + quality_risk(1-5)*-30
> 50 = high priority, 30-50 = medium, <30 = low
```
alice: maybe swap sign on eng_hours to reflect cost reducing score. but overall good. also add a required bench checklist: perf, embed parity, canary path, rollback plan.
dave: for canary path, recommend 2-week internal canary, then 1-week customer canary with traffic ramp 5%->25%->50%. must have auto-fallback to previous pinned variant.
eva: legal/sales can fast-track contract if we guarantee a rollback SLA and a dedicated capacity offer. they need the PT spec by EOD Friday to not lose momentum.
carla: action items: 1) ben to formalize rubric + scoring spreadsheet by tomorrow; 2) dave to run targeted perf test for falconx adapter and share failure traces; 3) alice to draft canary timeline and rollback SLA; 4) eva to align commercial ask and draft customer-facing promise.
ben: will do the spreadsheet. quick Q: should we treat pin length as additive to score (longer pin = higher revenue weight) or as gate?
alice: treat >=6mo as a gating special-exception needing exec signoff; score still used for placement in queue.
carla: agreed. also: if eng risk > 4 and quality_risk > 4 -> escalate to on-call ML lead for immediate mitigation planning.
sam-deploy-bot: scheduled perf-run job started: `perf-suite --target falconx-adapter --ctx 16k` (job id 78234).
dave: got it, monitoring logs now. will link traces in the spreadsheet.
eva: thanks team. want to keep comms tight with customer; i'll ask for a short meeting if we can hit the Friday spec.
carla: cool — will sync tomorrow 10am to review rubric and initial scores. :thumbsup:
alice: 10am works for me.
ben: added to my calendar.
carla: closing thread for now, will reopen if new asks come in.
